questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution prescribes the term of the President of India?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 56 specifies the term of the President as five years. The President holds office for five years unless removed earlier.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 56 राष्ट्रपति के पांच वर्ष के कार्यकाल का प्रावधान करता है। राष्ट्रपति का कार्यकाल सामान्यत: पांच वर्ष का होता है।

questions.question: Who presides over the Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairperson (Chairman) of the Rajya Sabha.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति पदेन राज्यसभा के सभापति होते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the election of the President of India:
(a) Elected MPs and elected MLAs vote.
(b) Value of MLA’s vote differs by state.
(c) Value of MP’s vote equals total value of MLA votes divided by number of MPs.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All three statements are correct. Only elected MPs and elected MLAs vote. The value of an MLA’s vote differs by state (based on population and the prescribed formula). The value of an MP’s vote is uniform and is calculated as: (Total value of votes of all elected MLAs) ÷ (Total number of elected MPs)..

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
तीनों कथन सही हैं। केवल निर्वाचित सांसद और निर्वाचित विधायक मतदान करते हैं। विधायक के वोट का मूल्य राज्यों के अनुसार जनसंख्या व निर्धारित सूत्र के आधार पर भिन्न होता है। सांसद के वोट का मूल्य समान होता है और उसे इस प्रकार निकाला जाता है: (सभी निर्वाचित विधायकों के कुल वोट-मूल्य) ÷ (निर्वाचित सांसदों की कुल संख्या)।

questions.question: The Vice-President of India is elected by:

options.a: Electoral College of both Houses of Parliament

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Under Article 66, the Vice-President is elected by an electoral college consisting of members of both Houses of Parliament. MLAs do not vote.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 66 के अंतर्गत उपराष्ट्रपति का चुनाव दोनों सदनों के सांसदों के इलेक्टोरल कॉलेज द्वारा होता है; विधायकों का इसमें मतदान नहीं होता।

questions.question: Which body is primarily responsible for advising the President in exercise of his functions?

options.b: Council of Ministers headed by the PM

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
By constitutional convention and Article 74, the President acts on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 74 एवं संवैधानिक परंपरा के अनुसार राष्ट्रपति को मंत्रिपरिषद् (PM के नेतृत्व में) की सलाह पर कार्य करना होता है।

questions.question: A Minister who is not a Member of Parliament must get elected to either House within how many months from appointment?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Constitution provides that a non-MP minister must become a member of either House within six months of appointment.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान के अनुसार सांसद न होने पर मंत्री को नियुक्ति के छह महीनों के भीतर संसद के किसी भी सदन का सदस्य बनना आवश्यक है।

questions.question: Which Article provides for the office of the President of India?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 52 specifically provides for the office of the President. Other articles (53–61) deal with powers, election, term, etc.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 52 में राष्ट्रपति के पद का प्रावधान है; अनुच्छेद 53–61 में उनके अधिकार और चुनाव के नियम हैं।

questions.question: How long may the Rajya Sabha be prorogued by the President without meeting?

options.a: No fixed maximum; but Parliament must meet within 6 months

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
There is no specific constitutional maximum for prorogation of a House, but Article 85 requires Parliament to meet at least once every six months.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 85 के अनुसार संसद छह माह से अधिक न रुके; प्रोरोगेशन का कोई स्वतंत्र अधिकतम समय नहीं दिया गया है।

questions.question: Which of the following is TRUE about Money Bills?

options.a: They can be introduced only in Lok Sabha.
options.b: Rajya Sabha can amend Money Bills without restriction.
options.c: Speaker’s certificate is not required to classify a Bill as Money Bill.
options.d: Money Bills do not need President’s prior approval before introduction.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Money Bills must be introduced only in Lok Sabha; Rajya Sabha can only recommend changes within 14 days; Speaker certifies Money Bill.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मनी बिल केवल लोकसभा में ही पेश होते हैं; राज्यसभा केवल 14 दिनों में सुझाव दे सकती है; स्पीकर मनी बिल का प्रमाणपत्र देते हैं।

questions.question: Who has the power to dissolve the Lok Sabha?

options.a: President acting on aid & advice of Council of Ministers

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The President dissolves the Lok Sabha, but in practice does so on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers led by the PM.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लोकसभा का भंग राष्ट्रपति द्वारा किया जाता है, परन्तु यह आम तौर पर मंत्रिमंडल की सलाह पर होता है।

questions.question: Which Article states that the Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 75(3) provides that the Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the House of the People (Lok Sabha).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 75(3) के अनुसार मंत्रिपरिषद लोकसभा के प्रति सामूहिक रूप से उत्तरदायी है।

questions.question: A Joint Sitting of Parliament can be called to resolve a deadlock on:

options.c: Ordinary Bill that is passed by one House and rejected by other

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Joint sittings are for ordinary bills where the two Houses disagree; Money Bills and Constitution Amendment Bills are excluded.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संयुक्त सत्र साधारण विधेयकों के लिए बुलाया जाता है यदि दोनों सदनों के बीच मतभेद हों; मनी बिल व संविधान संशोधन इसके बाहर हैं।

questions.question: Who certifies whether a bill is a Money Bill?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Speaker of Lok Sabha has the exclusive authority to certify a bill as a Money Bill. This certification is final.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मनी बिल होने की प्रमाण-पत्र स्पीकर देते हैं और उनका निर्णय अंतिम रहता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following about the President’s ordinance-making power:
(a) Ordinances can be promulgated only when Parliament is not in session.
(b) Ordinance has same force as an Act of Parliament.
(c) Ordinance can amend the Constitution.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ordinances are issued only when Parliament is not in session and have the force of law, but cannot be used to amend the Constitution.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अध्यादेश संसद सत्र ना होने पर ही जारी होता है और वह कानून का समान प्रभाव रखता है; लेकिन संविधान संशोधन की शक्ति इसमें नहीं है।

questions.question: Who appoints the Attorney General of India?

options.a: President on advice of the cabinet

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Attorney General is appointed by the President and is the central government's chief legal advisor; appointment follows PM/Cabinet advice.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अटॉर्नी-जनरल की नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति द्वारा की जाती है, पर यह प्रधानमंत्री/कबिनेट की सलाह पर होती है।

questions.question: Which House of Parliament is permanent and cannot be dissolved?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rajya Sabha is a permanent body; it is a continuing chamber with one-third members retiring every two years. Lok Sabha can be dissolved.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राज्यसभा एक स्थायी सदन है जिसमें हर दो वर्षों में एक-तिहाई सदस्य सेवानिवृत्त होते हैं; लोकसभा को भंग किया जा सकता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about removal of the President:
(a) Only a resolution is needed in one House.
(b) Grounds are violation of Constitution.
(c) A special majority of both Houses is required.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Impeachment is for violation of Constitution; it requires initiation and passage by both Houses with special majority; statement (a) is wrong because both Houses must act.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
महाभियोग केवल संविधान उल्लंघन के लिए है; दोनों सदनों में विशेष बहुमत से पारित होना चाहिए; (a) गलत है।

questions.question: Who is the real head of the executive in practice in India?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Though President is the nominal head, real executive authority in practice lies with the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राष्ट्रपति नाममात्र प्रमुख हैं; वास्तविक कार्यकारी शक्ति प्रधानमंत्री व मंत्रिपरिषद के पास होती है।

questions.question: Which article deals with the election of the Vice-President?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 66 provides for the election of the Vice-President by members of both Houses of Parliament.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 66 में उपराष्ट्रपति के चुनाव का प्रावधान है; चुनाव दोनों सदनों के सांसद करते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Speaker of the Lok Sabha?

options.a: Presiding over joint sittings of Parliament

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The President appoints the Prime Minister; Speaker does preside over joint sittings, certifies Money Bills, and decides disqualification matters.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रधानमंत्री की नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति करते हैं; स्पीकर संयुक्त सत्र की अध्यक्षता करते हैं व मनी बिल प्रमाणित करते हैं और दसवीं अनुसूची के तहत निर्णय लेते हैं।

questions.question: What is the minimum quorum for a sitting of the Lok Sabha?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 100 states that the quorum of either House is one-tenth of the total number of members of that House.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 100 के अनुसार किसी भी सदन के लिए कोरम कुल सदस्यों का एक-दशमांश होता है।

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Constitution allocates seats to states in the Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Fourth Schedule provides allocation of seats in Rajya Sabha to the States and Union Territories.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चतुर्थ अनुसूची में राज्यसभा में राज्यों तथा केन्द्र शासित प्रदेशों की सीटों का आवंटन दिया गया है।

questions.question: A Financial Bill (I) requires which precondition before introduction in Parliament?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Financial Bills (Part I) affecting taxation and government receipts require prior recommendation of the President before introduction.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कर संबंधी वित्तीय बिल (I) संसद में पेश होने से पहले राष्ट्रपति की अनुशंसा आवश्यक होती है।

questions.question: Which of the following may the President do in the case of a Bill passed by Parliament?

options.a: Return the Bill for reconsideration (except Money Bills)

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
President can assent, withhold assent, or (except for Money Bills) return a bill to Parliament for reconsideration.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राष्ट्रपति सहमति दे सकते हैं, अस्वीकार कर सकते हैं, या (मनी बिल को छोड़कर) पुनर्विचार के लिए विधेयक लौटा सकते हैं।

questions.question: Which Article establishes the office of the Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister at the head?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 74 provides for Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister as its head to aid and advise the President.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 74 में मंत्रीपरिषद का प्रावधान है, जिसका नेतृत्व प्रधानमंत्री करते हैं और जो राष्ट्रपति की सहायता व सलाह देती है।

questions.question: Which House is competent to initiate a Money Bill?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Only the Lok Sabha can initiate a Money Bill; Rajya Sabha may only recommend amendments which Lok Sabha may accept or reject.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
केवल लोकसभा ही मनी बिल शुरू कर सकती है; राज्यसभा को केवल संशोधन सुझाने का अधिकार है।

questions.question: Who has the authority to decide questions of disqualification of members under the Tenth Schedule?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Speaker of Lok Sabha decides disqualification questions for Lok Sabha members; for Rajya Sabha, the Chairman (Vice-President) decides.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लोकसभा के लिए स्पीकर और राज्यसभा के लिए अध्यक्ष (उपराष्ट्रपति) दसवीं अनुसूची के तहत अयोग्यता के प्रश्नों का निर्णय करते हैं।

questions.question: The President may declare National Emergency under which Article?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 352 empowers the President to proclaim National Emergency on grounds of war, external aggression or armed rebellion.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 352 के अंतर्गत युद्ध, विदेशी आक्रमण या सशस्त्र विद्रोह के आधार पर राष्ट्रपति राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल घोषित कर सकते हैं।

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about Rajya Sabha is/are correct?
(a) It represents the States and UTs.
(b) Its members are elected by MLAs and nominated by the President.
(c) It can initiate Money Bill.
 Choose:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rajya Sabha represents states; members elected by MLAs and 12 nominated by President; it cannot initiate Money Bills.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राज्यसभा का प्रतिनिधित्व राज्यों का है; उसके सदस्य विधायकों द्वारा चुने जाते हैं व राष्ट्रपति द्वारा 12 नामित किए जाते हैं; मनी बिल वह शुरू नहीं कर सकती।

questions.question: What majority is required to pass a Constitutional Amendment Bill in Parliament (unless specified otherwise)?

options.c: Special majority of two-thirds of members present and voting & majority of total membership

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Constitutional amendments generally require special majority: two-thirds of members present and voting and a majority of total membership; some amendments also need ratification by states.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सामान्यतः संविधान संशोधन के लिए उपस्थित और मतदान करने वालों के 2/3 का विशेष बहुमत व कुल सदस्य संख्या का बहुमत आवश्यक होता है; कुछ मामलों में राज्यों की स्वीकृति भी चाहिए।

questions.question: Which of the following is true about the Prime Minister’s appointment?

options.a: Prime Minister is directly elected by people.
options.b: President appoints the leader of the majority party or coalition in Lok Sabha as PM.
options.c: PM must be a member of Rajya Sabha.
options.d: PM is appointed by the Speaker.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
President appoints as PM the leader who has majority support in Lok Sabha; if no majority, President chooses someone who is most likely to command a majority.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राष्ट्रपति प्रधानमंत्री के रूप में उस नेता को नियुक्त करते हैं जिसके पास लोकसभा में बहुमत समर्थन हो; हंग पारा में वे ऐसे व्यक्ति का चयन करते हैं जो बहुमत जुटा सके।

questions.question: Who can remove the Vice-President from office?

options.b: A resolution of Rajya Sabha agreed by Lok Sabha

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Vice-President may be removed by a resolution of the Rajya Sabha which is agreed to by the Lok Sabha — a specified process under the Constitution.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
उपराष्ट्रपति को राज्यसभा के उस प्रस्ताव द्वारा हटाया जा सकता है जिसे लोकसभा द्वारा भी अनुमोदित किया गया हो।

questions.question:
Consider the following about the President’s role in law-making:
(a) Every bill passed by Parliament becomes law only after President’s assent.
(b) President can return a bill (other than Money Bill) for reconsideration.
(c) President can refuse assent forever and the bill will never become law.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
President’s assent is necessary; he may return a non-Money Bill once. However, if Parliament passes again, President must assent — so refusal forever is not absolute.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राष्ट्रपति की सहमति आवश्यक होती है; वे मनी बिल को छोड़कर किसी बिल को एक बार लौटा सकते हैं; यदि संसद पुनः पास कर दे तो राष्ट्रपति को सहमति देनी होगी।

questions.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India is appointed by the President under which Article?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 148 establishes the office of CAG and provides for appointment by the President. CAG audits government accounts.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 148 के अंतर्गत CAG के पद का प्रावधान है और उनकी नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति द्वारा होती है; CAG सरकारी खातों का लेखा परीक्षण करते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about a no-confidence motion is correct?

options.a: It is moved in Rajya Sabha.
options.b: If passed, the Council of Ministers must resign.
options.c: It can be moved against an individual Minister only.
options.d: President decides the result of the motion.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
No-confidence motion is moved in Lok Sabha; if passed, the Council of Ministers including PM must resign.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नॅो-कन्फिडेंस प्रस्ताव लोकसभा में रखा जाता है; यदि पारित हो जाता है तो मंत्रिपरिषद को इस्तीफा देना होगा।

questions.question: Which body recommends President’s impeachment procedure and time limits in the Constitution?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Constituent Assembly framed the provisions regarding impeachment (Articles 61 etc.) as part of the Constitution.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संविधान सभा ने राष्ट्रपति के महाभियोग से सम्बन्धित प्रावधान (जैसे अनुच्छेद 61) संविधान में शामिल किये।

questions.question: The Prime Minister’s responsibility to the Parliament is mainly based on which principle?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The PM leads the Council of Ministers which is collectively responsible to Lok Sabha — the core of parliamentary government.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रधानमंत्री मंत्रिपरिषद के नेतृत्वकर्ता हैं और मंत्रिपरिषद लोकसभा के प्रति सामूहिक रूप से उत्तरदायी होती है।

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The President can nominate 12 members to the Rajya Sabha who have special knowledge or practical experience in literature, science, art or social service.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राष्ट्रपति 12 सदस्यों को नामित कर सकते हैं जो साहित्य, विज्ञान, कला या सामाजिक सेवा में विशेषज्ञ हों।

questions.question: Which of the following is a discretionary power of the President?

options.a: Giving assent to every bill passed by Parliament
options.b: Appointing the Prime Minister in a hung Parliament
options.c: Appointing Governor of a State on PM advice / PM
options.d: Acting on aid and advice of the Council of Ministers

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In a hung Parliament, President exercises discretion in appointing a PM likely to command majority; other functions are largely on ministers’ advice.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हंग संसद की स्थिति में राष्ट्रपति प्रधानमंत्री नियुक्त करने में विवेक का प्रयोग करते हैं; अन्य मामलों में वे आमतौर पर मंत्रिपरिषद की सलाह पर कार्य करते हैं।

questions.question: What majority is required in Lok Sabha to pass an ordinary bill?

options.a: Simple majority of members present and voting
options.c: Special majority of two-thirds of members present and voting

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
An ordinary bill requires a simple majority of members present and voting to pass in a House.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
साधारण विधेयक पारित करने के लिए उपस्थित और मतदान करने वाले सदस्यों की साधारण बहुमत पर्याप्त है।

questions.question: Which official presides over Lok Sabha in the absence of the Speaker?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Deputy Speaker presides over the Lok Sabha when the Speaker is absent. If both are absent, a member appointed by the Speaker or in absence by the House presides.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्पीकर अनुपस्थित होने पर उप-स्पीकर लोकसभा की अध्यक्षता करते हैं; दोनों अनुपस्थित हों तो स्पीकर द्वारा नामित सदस्य या सदन उपस्थिति संभालेगा।

questions.question:
Consider the following about the removal of a Judge of the Supreme Court: (trick to test understanding of separation) — (note: not in direct topic but relevant to Parliament’s powers)
(a) Removal is through impeachment by Parliament.
(b) A simple majority in both Houses is enough.
(c) Trial takes place in Parliament and President orders removal after motion passes.
 Which are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Judges of SC/HC are removed by impeachment (parliamentary process) — trial in Parliament and President acts on outcome; special majority (not simple) is required, so (b) is wrong.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सुप्रीम कोर्ट के जज महाभियोग प्रक्रिया द्वारा हटाये जा सकते हैं; परीक्षण संसद में होता है और पास होने पर राष्ट्रपति हटाने का आदेश देते हैं; सरल बहुमत पर्याप्त नहीं है।

questions.question: Which of the following is TRUE about the President’s power to pardon?

options.a: President can pardon death sentence only on PM’s advice.
options.b: President’s power to pardon is absolute and non-justiciable.
options.c: President can grant pardon, reprieve, respite or remit sentences.
options.d: President cannot commute a death sentence to life imprisonment.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Article 72 empowers the President to grant pardons, reprieves, respites or remissions; exercise is generally on aid and advice of Council of Ministers but is justiciable in limited circumstances.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अनुच्छेद 72 के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रपति दंड माफ, रियायत या शेषांश माफ कर सकते हैं; यह सलाह पर होता है और कुछ स्थितियों में अदालत द्वारा जांच भी की जा सकती है।

questions.question: The Budget (Annual Financial Statement) is presented to Parliament by the:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Finance Minister presents the Union Budget to the Parliament annually; it is a responsibility of the executive through the FM.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वार्षिक बजट वित्त मंत्री द्वारा संसद में प्रस्तुत किया जाता है; यह कार्यपालिका की जिम्मेदारी के माध्यम से होता है।

questions.question: Within how many days must the Rajya Sabha return recommendations on a Money Bill to the Lok Sabha?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Rajya Sabha must return any recommendations on a Money Bill within 14 days; Lok Sabha may accept or reject those recommendations.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मनी बिल पर राज्यसभा की सिफारिशें 14 दिनों के भीतर लोकसभा को वापस करनी होती हैं; लोकसभा उन्हें स्वीकार या अस्वीकार कर सकती है।
